@AbapCatalog.viewEnhancementCategory: [#NONE]
@AccessControl.authorizationCheck: #NOT_REQUIRED
@EndUserText.label: 'Upload PO - Header (Intf.)'
@VDM.viewType: #COMPOSITE
define view entity ZEXED_I_UP_PDCMP_H
  as select from zexed_up_pdcmp_h

  association [0..1] to I_BusinessUserBasic      as _UserCreate             on $projection.LocalCreatedBy = _UserCreate.UserID
  association [0..1] to I_BusinessUserBasic      as _UserChange             on $projection.LocalLastChangedBy = _UserChange.UserID
  association [0..1] to I_CompanyCode            as _Company                on $projection.CompanyCode = _Company.CompanyCode
  association [0..1] to I_Supplier               as _Supplier               on $projection.Supplier = _Supplier.Supplier
  //  association [0..1] to I_PurchasingDocumentType as _PurchasingDocumentType on  _PurchasingDocumentType.PurchasingDocumentCategory = 'F' //purchase order
  //                                                                            and $projection.PurchaseOrderType2                     = _PurchasingDocumentType.PurchasingDocumentType

  association [0..1] to I_PurchasingOrganization as _PurchasingOrganization on $projection.PurchaseOrganization = _PurchasingOrganization.PurchasingOrganization

  association [0..1] to I_PurchasingGroup        as _PurchasingGroup        on $projection.PurchaseGroup = _PurchasingGroup.PurchasingGroup

  association [0..1] to I_PaymentTerms           as _PaymentTerms           on $projection.PaymentTerms = _PaymentTerms.PaymentTerms

  association        to parent ZEXED_I_UP_PDCMP  as _File                   on $projection.ParentUUID = _File.UUID

  composition [0..*] of ZEXED_I_UP_PDCMP_I       as _Itens
{
  key  uuid                                                        as UUID,
       parent_uuid                                                 as ParentUUID,
       status                                                      as Status,
       case status
        when 'Erro'          then 1
        when 'Não publicado' then 2
        when 'Publicado'     then 3
        else 0
       end                                                         as CriticalityStatus,
       purchase_order                                              as PurchaseOrder,
       concat_with_space('Pedido:',ltrim( purchase_order, '0' ),1) as LabelPurchaseOrder,
       purchase_order_type                                         as PurchaseOrderType2,
       purchase_order_date                                         as PurchaseOrderDate,
       company_code                                                as CompanyCode,
       purchase_org                                                as PurchaseOrganization,
       purchase_grp                                                as PurchaseGroup,
       supplier                                                    as Supplier,
       payment_terms                                               as PaymentTerms,
       miro_header_text                                            as MiroHeaderText,
       _Company.CompanyCodeName                                    as CompanyName,
       _Supplier.BPSupplierFullName                                as SupplierName,
       _PurchasingOrganization.PurchasingOrganizationName          as PurchaseOrganizationName,
       _PurchasingGroup.PurchasingGroupName                        as PurchaseGroupName,
       @Semantics.user.createdBy: true
       local_created_by                                            as LocalCreatedBy,

       _UserCreate.PersonFullName                                  as NameUserCreate,

       @Semantics.systemDateTime.createdAt: true
       local_created_at                                            as LocalCreatedAt,

       @Semantics.user.lastChangedBy: true
       local_last_changed_by                                       as LocalLastChangedBy,

       _UserChange.PersonFullName                                  as NameUserChange,

       @Semantics.systemDateTime.localInstanceLastChangedAt: true
       local_last_changed_at                                       as LocalLastChangedAt,

       @Semantics.systemDateTime.lastChangedAt: true
       last_changed_at                                             as LastChangedAt,
       //Associations
       _File,
       _Itens
}
